brief: Flow board (Lean study K1). Today nothing measures throughput against the owner's demand of one roster group merged per hour, so no flow change can show it worked. Extend tools/audit/merge_throughput.py with a flow subcommand rather than adding a file: read the first-parent log of origin/main, the review and verdict bus refs (tools/audit/seat/bus.sh publishes one commit per verdict, subject 'verdict: #N Fix review: merge|blocked <sha> <class>: ...'), and the roster through tools/audit/seat/roster_lib.py. Print per rolling hour and per 24 h: roster groups closed against takt 1.0; fly-ins closed; main moves split into group-carrying, record, roster-edit and fly-in; work in progress by flow lane (A critical path, B product, C process, F fly-in); first-pass yield of fix review and the blocked-class mix; lead time per size. Add it to tools/audit/seat/state_docs.py's generator list so the beat publishes it beside the plan table, and print UNAVAILABLE, never zeros, when a source is unreadable. Wire its self-test into governance.yml's instrument-self-tests job. Controls: a fixture with one merge, one blocked then merged verdict and one record merge gives exact counts; a null control (an unchanged fixture) reads identical before and after; its mutants fail named arms.
